notes.title: Receiver Localization Update 2.2.0
notes.content:
In this update we haven't just fixed some bugs and added some minor quality of life improvements, but we also added official support for a couple of languages!

The languages include ui translations, in world text translations and subtitles for all tapes. So this is more in line with what some might call a sub rather than a dub.

The Languages in question are:

[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Chinese (Mainland)
[*] Japanese
[/list]

In addition, the following changes, bugfixes and tweaks have been made:

[list]
[*]Added broom to Compound, allowing players to clean up spent casings
[*]Added more detailed trigger weight system
[*]Added separate "Instrumental" and "Vocal" sliders for background music
[*]Added subtitles for "Isolation Set" tapes
[*]Added "Community" tag to community translations
[*]Added one time language detection based on system language
[*]Added the ability to specify tape order in custom campaigns
[*]Added subtitle support to Remetronic
[*]Added support for Vulkan on Windows [-force-vulkan]
[*]Added support for OpenGL on MacOS [-force-glcore]

[*]Adjusted amount of "clean" shots after cleaning from 100-120 to 200-240
[*]Adjusted singing sound muffle when listening to tapes

[*]Fixed flares shining through walls when using OpenGL [-force-glcore] (Linux)
[*]Fixed transparent pause menu when using Vulkan (Linux)
[*]Fixed FMOD library file issues (Linux)
[*]Fixed a bunch of stability issues on Vulkan. [-force-vulkan] (Linux)

[*]Fixed golden guns not properly loading in custom campaigns
[*]Fixed various layout/font issues for different languages
[*]Fixed unobtainable note in Compound
[*]Fixed "Voice Volume" slider being mislabled as "Soften Gun Sound"
[*]Fixed game restarting when Steam is not running
[*]Fixed "True Receiver" achievement not working as intended
[*]Fixed various performance issues
[*]Fixed initial tile ignoring WorldGeneration configuration in custom campaigns
[*]Fixed gun tutorials not being disabled when disabling tutorials
[*]Fixed being able to cheese "Pacifist" achievement by restarting
[*]Fixed Threat Echo being unable to cock the SAA
[*]Fixed potential corruption issues when saving outside level bounds
[*]Fixed tiles not loading when walking on the roof of certain tiles
[*]Fixed UI elements being visible through the letterboxes in pause menu
[*]Fixed error when interacting with Challenge Dome on a new save
[*]Fixed deathscreen possibly being stuck when using INSIGHT cheat
[*]Fixed an issue with tape playlists
[*]Fixed scores sometimes falsely counting as par scores
[*]Fixed world trophies immiting sounds when held
[/list]

notes.title: Receiver 2 Minor Update 2.1.2
notes.content:
A new update for Receiver 2 is out! This one is a little bigger than our usual minor updates consisting of 364 changes. We won't list them all, but here are some of the highlights!

[list]
[*] Added ability to queue up tapes from the menu and listen to them in game.
[*] Challenge score now have three tiers: Gold, Silver, and Par, allowing a greater challenge for more advanced Receivers.
[*] Tweaked all high-scores for the compound challenges.
[*] New language select option in the settings menu, allowing players to test out in progress community translations! Including Traditional Chinese, Czech, Finnish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Turkish.
[*] Optimized some texture sizes to reduce VRAM use.
[*] Fixed a bug where cleaning kit unlock message would be shown multiple times.
[*] Remove glowing skylights from Liminal.
[*] Fixed some reflection probes and other visual glitches in the Compound.
[*] Fixed bullet holes glowing in some situations.
[*] Made save-game files significantly smaller, improving performance when saving and loading.
[*] Tweaked some sounds in the compound.
[/list]

notes.title: Receiver 2 Achievements Update 2.0.6
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129310/Receiver_2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280510/Receiver_2_Soundtrack
Receiver 2 now has Steam achievements, along with a bunch of other changes!
[list][*]Added Steam achievements.
[*]Sleeper turrets now have a tiny red light and more appealing wake-up visuals.
[*]Magazines now vary in quality, which affects the rate of double feed and
other malfunctions.
[*]There's now a very slight chance that automatics discharge when being
racked.
[*]It's now possible to disabled head bobbing in the settings.
[*]Added additional previously missing subtitle files.
[*]Added a setting to disable subtitles.
[*]Made all subtitles consists of 42 or less characters per row, this will
enable us to support lower resolutions and larger font sizes in the future,
improving readability.
[*]Made multiple small improvements to runtime performance.
[*]Made it possible to change dynamic decal limits in settings for lower end machines.
[*]Made a change to gun behaviour where the hammer on some models can get
caught on brush and get cocked in the holster.
[*][strike]Made it impossible for the player to continue picking up tapes after finding
the final one.[/strike]
[*]Made it so that the session resets if you die on the first rank.
[*]Added an additional ND case for the SAA.
[*]Added a framerate limiter to the menues, reducing GPU usage when paused.
[*]How many secret notes you've found is now listed in the statistics menu.
[*]Made extracted casing fly out relative the guns velocity, and not the
player's.
[*]Made it so the SAA cylinder can't spin unless all rounds are seated
correctly.
[*]Added a slow fadeout when falling to your death.
[*]Dying from falling down to the street now has a unique death message.
[*]Upgraded to Unity version 2019.4.8f1 improving performance and stability.
[*]Optimized a large set of textures, reducing VRAM, disk space usage and
improves load times.
[*]Fixed a null reference error related to TV's.
[*]Fixed a softlock issue occuring when playing with the debug gun.
[*]Fixed a logspam error related to invalid magazine.
[*]Fixed the tape count number on the death screen.
[*]Fixed a codesigning issue on MacOSX.
[*]Fixed the ammo boxes in the shooting range, it's not possible to get ammo again.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where sometimes a tiny round would appear in the chamber
after shooting yourself.
[*]Fixed a visual clipping issue on the deagle magazine.
[*]Fixed a nullref error from happening when hacking turrets.
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes resulted in rounds being unseated when spawning
with a loaded revolver.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes other rounds than the one being fired expanded
in the chambers.
[*]Improved tape playback control in the menu.
[*]Improved the background pattern on the statistics screen.
[*]Improved the font and background image for subtitles.
[*]Improved rendering performance for our custom lights.
[*]Improved rendering performance of the skybox.
[*]Improved rendering performance of bullet decals.
[*]Improved glint behaviour on items.
[*]Improved round ejection behaviour on both revolvers and automatics.
[*]Improved the visual quality of the shadows cast from the Turret, Drone and
Security Camera.
[/list]

notes.title: Receiver 2 Minor Update 2.0.2
notes.content:
We just released the Receiver 2.0.2 update, in this update we aimed to fix many of the performance issues that have been affecting certain users.
[list][*] Add FOV slider in settings.
[*] Add FPS limiter slider in settings.
[*] Greatly reduced VRAM usage during gameplay.
[*] Multiple optimizations to both cpu and gpu routines, making the game run smoother.
[*] Fixed a bug where tape counter would go beyond target value.
[*] Fixed a bug where tapes wouldn't be counted after being picked up.
[*] Fixed a bug where saves would sometimes be corrupt and causing the game would be stuck in an endless loading loop.
[*] Updated some texts in-game to make them clearer.
[*] Added on-screen rank logo indicating current rank.
[*] Added prevention from saving mid-air.
[*] Added prevention from saving when in fatal air velocity.
[*] Added prevention from saving when already dead from a bullet wound.
[*] Adjusted holstering animation to better mirror safe-state.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129310/Receiver_2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280510/Receiver_2_Soundtrack

notes.title: Receiver 2 Minor Update 2.0.1
notes.content:
The 2.0.1 update for Receiver 2 is OUT NOW, featuring many of your most-requested changes and tweaks.
[list][*] Save progress on quit instead of losing rank, updated exit message to specify that progress will be saved.
[*] Progress is autosaved after every rank up or death.
[*] Sprint key acts as “walk” key when “hold to sprint” mode is disabled.
[*] Disabled “tap to sprint” when "hold to sprint" mode is enabled.
[*] In “hold to sprint” mode, sprint key acts as a modifier for forward key.
[*] Desert Eagle negligent discharge now kills the player in one hit instead of two.
[*] Enemy spotlights now get blocked by walls even on "fastest" and "fast" quality levels.
[*] Made sure all tapes are the latest revisions, this should fix tape/transcript discrepancies.
[*] Can customize "jump" key binding.
[*] Can customize "kill player" key binding.
[*] Added dialog when setting a conflicting keybind.
[*] Fixed crash bug (the one that made the memory usage appear to grow forever).
[*] Fixed massive log file size.
[*] Fixes to stats system.
[*] Fixed some occasional reflection problems (bright flash on AMD, black on nVidia).
[*] Fixed "reset defaults" command in keybinding menu.
[*] Fixed problems when customizing keybinds.
[*] Fixed "swing out cylinder" keybind.
[*] Fixed several asset placement and rendering issues in various tiles.
[*] Fixed graphics glitches when breaking glass on Linux.
[*] Fixed clicking sound when pulling back Colt Detective hammer.
[*] Fixed error message when shooting Newton's Cradle.
[*] Fixed problems with gun operation/guns getting stuck during and after threat echo event.
[*] Fixed problem with ending.
[*] Fixed various minor bugs.
[*] Fixed various typos.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129310/Receiver_2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280510/Receiver_2_Soundtrack
